raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

`test_mooncake_resend_reuses_prompt_checkpoint` in `(4xB200) [Nightly] Kimi K3 Prefix Cache Shard 1/4` has failed since #54163 ([nightly 96830](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/96830#01a1675c-cf11-4cdd-af5a-33204d20a817)):

```
AssertionError: prompt_len=7449: actual=7424, expected=7296
```

#54163 stopped DFlash/DSpark from dropping the trailing prefix-cache unit (`needs_eagle_block_drop()`). These tests run DSpark but still expect the EAGLE drop. This PR updates the expected hit to the last 128-token checkpoint before the final token, `(P - 1) // 128 * 128`, and rewrites the comments that described the drop.

## Claims

- The Mooncake resend test now expects 7424 of 7449 cached tokens, which is what CI observes after #54163 removed the drop.
- The two `test_dspark_exact_resend_reuses_prompt_checkpoint` cases are unchanged in value. P=7040 and P=7296 are 128-aligned, so the old and new formulas agree. Only their comments and ids change: `eagle-proof-scan` becomes `pmu-aligned-tail`, and `eagle-double-cap` becomes `single-cap`.

## Validation

| Test | `main` | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| `test_mooncake_resend_reuses_prompt_checkpoint` | fails in [nightly 96830](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/96830#01a1675c-cf11-4cdd-af5a-33204d20a817): `actual=7424, expected=7296` | expects 7424; not run locally (see below) |
| `test_dspark_exact_resend_reuses_prompt_checkpoint[pmu-aligned-tail, single-cap]` | pass in CI | pass locally on GB300 (same expected values) |

```bash
pytest -v -s tests/models/kimi_k3/test_prefix_cache.py -k resend_reuses_prompt_checkpoint
```

The Mooncake case could not run on my GB300 box: Mooncake RDMA cannot register GPU memory there (`register_buffer failed ... -600`), so every store put fails and the resend hits 0. It needs the B200 nightly step: `actual=7424` comes from the CI log above. The hit-count assertion runs before `check_logprobs_close`, so since #54163 CI has not compared logprobs for this case; the nightly run on this PR checks that too.

## Details

**Coverage gap.** This file only uses DSpark, so after #54163 nothing here exercises the EAGLE trailing-unit drop with hybrid Mamba prefix caching. That includes the "attention proof" lookups that #60695 was testing. `_expected_cached` in the multi-turn test still subtracts a unit for spec modes. I left it as is: it is only a lower bound (`cached >= expected`), and the NIXL P/D path still keys off `use_eagle()`. Covering EAGLE again needs an EAGLE/MTP draft for the 8-layer dummy model, which is out of scope here.

**Not a duplicate.** I searched open PRs for `test_mooncake_resend_reuses_prompt_checkpoint`, `resend_reuses_prompt_checkpoint`, "kimi k3 prefix cache test" and `54163`. No open PR touches this test. #62141 (AMD mirror) and #54165 cover different things.

AI assistance was used. No model evaluation: test-only change.

---

- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.

@@ -378,7 +378,7 @@ def _format(turns: list[Turn]) -> str:
 def _check_resend_reuses_prompt_checkpoint(
     deployment: Deployment, prompt_len: int
 ) -> None:
-    """Resends reuse the Mamba checkpoint and its companion EAGLE attention proof."""
+    """Resends reuse the last prompt checkpoint before the final token."""
     mode = Mode(128, True)
     salt = str(uuid4())
     rng = random.Random(0)
@@ -391,8 +391,8 @@ def _check_resend_reuses_prompt_checkpoint(
         resend = _complete(url, prompt, salt, max_tokens=1)
         recompute = _complete(url, prompt, f"{salt}-recompute", max_tokens=1)
 
-    # EAGLE's dropped hash unit already leaves tokens to recompute on resend.
-    expected = (prompt_len // 128 - 1) * 128
+    # DSpark keeps the trailing hash unit, unlike EAGLE.
+    expected = (prompt_len - 1) // 128 * 128
     actual = _cached(resend)
     assert _cached(cold) == _cached(recompute) == 0
     assert actual == expected, f"{prompt_len=}: {actual=}, {expected=}"
@@ -408,13 +408,11 @@ def _check_resend_reuses_prompt_checkpoint(
     "prompt_len",
     [
         # Blocks=6144, PMU=128. P=7040 is PMU-aligned but not block-aligned:
-        # ensure lookup reads the cached attention proof at 7040 despite
-        # the final hit limit of 7039, then applies EAGLE's 128-token drop.
-        pytest.param(7040, id="eagle-proof-scan"),
+        # the final hit limit of 7039 puts the checkpoint at 6912.
+        pytest.param(7040, id="pmu-aligned-tail"),
         # Blocks=6144, PMU=128. P=7296 is an exact PMU multiple:
-        # ensure the Mamba checkpoint is 7168, not 7040 from applying both
-        # the P - 1 cap and EAGLE's 128-token drop.
-        pytest.param(7296, id="eagle-double-cap"),
+        # ensure the Mamba checkpoint is 7168, not 7040 from capping twice.
+        pytest.param(7296, id="single-cap"),
     ],
 )
 def test_dspark_exact_resend_reuses_prompt_checkpoint(prompt_len: int) -> None:
@@ -474,9 +472,9 @@ def mooncake_store(tmp_path, monkeypatch) -> Iterator[None]:
 
 @pytest.mark.usefixtures("mooncake_store")
 def test_mooncake_resend_reuses_prompt_checkpoint() -> None:
-    """Blocks=6144, PMU=128. P=7449 needs Mamba state at 7296 and attention proof
-    at 7424, both beyond the normal Mooncake save boundary of 6144: ensure they
-    remain reusable from the store after a GPU cache reset."""
+    """Blocks=6144, PMU=128. P=7449 needs Mamba state at 7424, beyond the normal
+    Mooncake save boundary of 6144: ensure it remains reusable from the store
+    after a GPU cache reset."""
     _check_resend_reuses_prompt_checkpoint(
         Deployment(Instance(kv_config=MOONCAKE), offload=True), 7449
     )
